full_judgment:
Mr. Syed Md. Ziaul Karim, J:- This appeal, at the instance of defendant no.2 appellant calls in question the legality and propriety of the Judgment and order dated 04-11-2007 passed by learned District Judge, Dhaka rejecting Misc. case no.748 of 2007 filed under order 41 rule 19 of the Code of Civil Procedure (briefly as the Code). 

 5. In suit, the defendant no. 2 by an application dated 12-09-2006 sought to reject the  plaint of the suit under Order 7 Rule 11 of the Code. The trial court by the order dated 08-02-2007 rejected the application. Against which the appellant preferred Civil Revision no.67 of 2007 before the High Court Division which was ultimately converted to appeal and referred to the District Judge for its disposal, who on receipt of the order registered the same as Misc. appeal no.38 of 2007 which was ultimately dismissed for default on 08-07-2007 for the cause of non- appearance of the appellant. Then, the appellant as petitioner preferred Misc. Case no.748 of 2007 under Order 41 Rule 19 of the Code for its re-admission. The court of appeal below ultimately rejected the same by the impugned order. Hence the appeal. 

 6. The learned advocate appearing for the appellant seeks to impeach the impugned order on two fold arguments. Firstly, the appellant was prevented by sufficient cause not to appear in the Court when the matter fir was called on for hearing. Secondly the .learned judge without appreciating the appellant's cause for non-appearance virtually considered his previous conduct and rejected the Misc. case causing serious miscarriage of justice. 

 10. Ongoing to materials on record it transpires that the Misc. appeal no.38 of 2007 was properly admitted by the court of appeal below and ultimately the same was fixed for hearing on 08-07-2007, but on that date the learned counsel for the appellant was found absent and the appeal was dismissed for default. Then the appellant as petitioner preferred Misc. case no.748 of 2007 under Order 41 Rule 19 of the Code for its re admission with a separate application for condonation of delay of 39 days which was rejected by the court below considering the previous conduct of the appellant. It is stated in the application that the learned counsel for the appellant could not appear in the court when the appeal was called on for hearing as he left the court premises to see his ailing mother but the court below without considering the sufficient cause and only considering the previous conduct of the appellant rejected the Misc. case. It is well settled that the previous conduct of the appellant maybe reprehensible but the matter (restoration of the appeal) cannot be decided on the ground of mere previous conduct. Whether he was prevented by sufficient cause from appearing when the appeal was called on for hearing will determine the outcome of the proceeding under order 41 rules 19 of the Code. On this count the impugned order cannot be sustained. More so the grounds taken in the application for re-admission of the appeal clearly indicate that the appellant was prevented by sufficient cause not to appear when the matter was called on for hearing. 

 13. In the result, the appeal is allowed. The impugned order dated 04-11-2007 passed in Misc. case no.748 of 2007 is hereby set aside and the Misc. case no.748 of 2007 is allowed. The court of appeal below is directed to re-admit the Misc. appeal no.38 of 2007 and to dispose of the same within two months from the date of receipt of this order.
